subject: eraevous/MtG
decision: Import the 2026-10-25 handoff code as-is (kb/, grammar/, review_packet/, evaluations/, predictions/) into the AEC-template repo, replace the template docs with MTG ones, and add a minimal AEC layer (project purpose, purpose files, drift_check, ledgers, CI). Restructuring comes later.
reason: One build rather than parallel builds. Reuse the existing implementation. Kate: 'The repository is infrastructure for the Magic project. The Magic project is not an excuse to build infrastructure.'

subject: codex_++/project.purpose.md
decision: Adopt P-00 (project purpose) plus P-01 to P-05, with P-01 amended so that unverified grammar and KB output stays a candidate, and authority scoped by subject rather than one linear ranking.
reason: Kate's review of the first draft: the original P-01 gave unreviewed automation too much authority, and the linear hierarchy let inventory appear to outrank Oracle.

subject: Vraska
decision: Vraska revision 1: Strixhaven Skycoach->Mechan Assembler, Boosted Sloop->Donatello Way with Machines, Springleaf Drum->Rally of Wings, Wurmwall Sweeper->Glassdust Hulk, Uthros Scanship->Disciple of the Sun, Resculpt->Duty Beyond Death (all free pool). Alternative 1-lite: first four swaps only.
reason: Zach's observed loss (no compounding, can't close, contention, no recovery). Interaction discovery found the engine has 1 artifact-enter receiver for its token output; the card-by-card baseline would instead cut token feeders. Evaluator cannot price the new triggers and has no opponents, so play-test.

subject: Vraska
decision: Supersedes D-0003's framing: Vraska revision 1 (full, 6 swaps) and 1-lite (4 swaps) are proposed as experiments testing different questions, not as improvements. Same swaps as D-0003. Freeze the revised prediction in the packet before the next Vraska game if one is adopted.
reason: Kate's PR #3 review: the receiver census is a classifier output, not a fact; Duty Beyond Death can't rebuild an empty board; recovery measured unchanged; costs in card flow are real.
